h1:
Mookata, Grill & Seafood Buffet
in Surat Thani, Worth the Price
intro: When people in Surat Thani want to meet up for dinner, mookata and grill buffets are usually the first thing that comes to mind. The city has everything from old-school joints by the Tapi River that have been around for twenty years to new spots tucked down side streets starting at just over a hundred baht. What sets this place apart is that a lot of the buffets throw in fresh seafood too, since the city sits right on Bandon Bay. We've picked 10 spots that are actually open right now based on reviews, with the price per head and the area for each one.

blocks.html: Before you pick a spot, it helps to sort them into three types — mookata / grill buffets focus on marinated meat over a charcoal stove and are the cheapest, seafood buffets add prawns, shellfish, and blue crab so the price goes up a bit, and combined hotpot + grill is for anyone who wants both boiling and grilling in one meal. Surat Thani has all three, and a lot of spots come out cheaper than you'd expect because the competition is fierce.

items.name: Long Lae Mookata
items.blurb: A legend among Bandon locals for over 20 years, with a chilled-out riverside vibe and a long buffet line that runs from marinated pork and seafood to fried snacks, yum salads, and refillable desserts. It's the first place locals think of when a big group wants to do grill night.
items.meta: Surat Thani city (Bandon) · dinner · grill + seafood

items.name: Mana Mookata Buffet
items.blurb: A newer spot with great pricing — 229 THB for adults including drinks, no time limit. Kids 6–11 are half price and under 6 eat free. There are several zones, from private booths to a riverside area and a kids' play area. The line has pork belly, scallops, and seafood, making it a solid family pick.

items.name: Osaka Buffet
items.blurb: A grill + grilled-seafood spot on the Samet Riang road. The draw here is the à la carte menu you can order on top of the buffet line, as much as you like. Reviewers say it goes all out on both the seafood and the grill menu — you'll leave full for under three hundred a head.
items.meta: Samet Riang road · grill + grilled seafood + à la carte

items.name: Umi Shabu
items.blurb: For anyone who wants both shabu and grill in one place. The line has wagyu, salmon, and Japanese dishes. Shabu starts at 319 and grill at 329, all in. It's a step up in price, but you get more premium ingredients than a standard mookata spot.
items.meta: Surat Thani city · shabu + grill · wagyu/salmon

items.name: 3 Bai Thao Mookata
items.blurb: A budget mookata buffet at 199 THB, all-you-can-eat with no time limit, on the Samet Riang road. Good for anyone on a tight budget or who wants to settle in for a long sit. Plenty of food for the price — nothing flashy, but it earns its keep.
items.meta: Samet Riang road · grill · no time limit

items.name: Talay Ja Seafood Buffet
items.blurb: A straight-up seafood buffet leaning on prawns, shellfish, blue crab, and fish, which you grill and boil yourself. Good for anyone who wants more seafood than pork. If you're in Surat Thani, it's worth trying a place in the land of big oysters at least once.
items.price: Check the price on-site (seafood buffet range)

items.name: Win Win Mookata
items.blurb: The buffet line is clearly split into zones — a pork zone, snacks, and a seafood zone — with no time limit. Reviews give it high marks for freshness and value, and it's a spot locals keep coming back to.
items.meta: Surat Thani city · grill + seafood · no time limit

items.name: Sangkasee
items.blurb: Has both a hotpot stove and a grill at the same table, so you can choose to boil or grill. Fresh shellfish is what reviewers mention most, in a relaxed, no-frills tavern-style setting.

items.name: Ratchanan Mookata Buffet
items.blurb: A mookata buffet that throws in all-you-can-eat seafood — prawns, crab, and fish — at a regular buffet price. Good for anyone who wants seafood but doesn't want to pay full seafood-restaurant rates.
items.meta: Surat Thani city · grill + all-you-can-eat seafood

items.name: Je Sao Mookata (Phunphin)
items.blurb: For anyone staying or getting off the train near Phunphin, this one saves you a trip into the city. It serves a pork belly set and a standard grill line at friendly prices — a handy option near Surat Thani railway station (Phunphin).
items.meta: Phunphin district (near the train station) · grill

blocks.title: How to pick a spot
blocks.html: If you're coming as a big group on a budget, go for a place that throws in seafood at the regular buffet price — like Mana, Long Lae, or Ratchanan — which works out cheaper than a dedicated seafood buffet. If you're after premium stuff (wagyu, salmon), step up to Umi Shabu.

blocks.text: Rough price per head by type

items: Standard mookata / grill buffet — around ฿199–229/person including drinks, many with no time limit
Grill + grilled seafood — around ฿249–299/person, adding prawns, scallops, and blue crab to the line
Combined shabu + grill (premium) — around ฿319–329/person, with imported meat, salmon, and Japanese dishes
Stove/equipment charge — some spots add ฿89–99 per grill stove, so ask up front before you sit down

blocks.text: Opening hours and booking a table

blocks.html: Most grill spots in Surat Thani open in the evening, around 16:30 onwards until about 22:00–22:30. Many are walk-in and don't take reservations. Tables tend to fill up between 18:00 and 20:00, especially on Friday and Saturday. If you're coming as a big group or want a good zone, aim for around 17:00 or after 20:00 — it's more relaxed.

items.name: Coming as a family
items.blurb: Pick a spot with a kids' play area and separate kids' pricing, like Mana Mookata — bring the whole family without worrying about the little ones.

items.name: Want lots of seafood
items.blurb: Head to Long Lae, Osaka, or Talay Ja, where the seafood line is long — fitting for the land of big oysters in southern Thailand.

items.name: On a budget
items.blurb: 3 Bai Thao at 199 THB or Mana at 229 THB — all-you-can-eat with no time limit, the best value on the list.

faq.q: Which Surat Thani mookata spot is the best value?
faq.a: By price per head, 3 Bai Thao is the cheapest starting at 199 THB. Mana Mookata at 229 THB includes drinks with no time limit and has scallops and seafood on the line too, which makes it great value for a family.

faq.q: Where should I go for a seafood buffet in Surat Thani?
faq.a: Long Lae Mookata, Osaka Buffet, and Talay Ja Seafood Buffet all have long seafood lines — prawns, shellfish, blue crab, and fish. Ratchanan Buffet also throws in all-you-can-eat seafood at a regular buffet price, which is great if you don't want to pay full seafood-restaurant rates.

faq.q: What time do grill spots in Surat Thani open, and do I need to book?
faq.a: Most open in the evening, around 16:30 to 22:00–22:30. Many are walk-in and don't take reservations. Tables fill up between 18:00 and 20:00, especially Friday and Saturday, so aim for around 17:00 or after 20:00 to get a seat more easily.

faq.q: Are there any grill spots near Surat Thani railway station?
faq.a: Surat Thani railway station is in Phunphin district, around 13 km from the city center. There are mookata spots near Phunphin like Je Sao Mookata so you don't have to go into town, but most of the well-known places are in the city center at Bandon.

faq.q: Do Surat Thani grill buffets charge extra for the stove?
faq.a: Some include the stove in the buffet price, but others — like Long Lae and Mana — may add 89–99 THB per grill stove. It's best to ask staff up front before you sit down so the bill doesn't come as a surprise.
